_readme: Branches whose work no open PR tracks and which a person has decided about. Same bar as every other ledger here: entries are discussed decisions, never added to make a check pass. `disposition` says what was decided. TERMINAL (LANDED: main has it by content or by an equivalent change; SUPERSEDED: a newer implementation replaced it; ABANDONED: it will not ship) makes the branch EXCLUDED and closes its recovery task. OPEN (INTENTIONAL_HOLD, NEEDS_EVIDENCE, DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED) keeps the task open as HELD: the work is still not on main, it never alerts and it is never recovered automatically. An entry with no disposition reads as ABANDONED (every entry before 2026-11-17). `tip` pins the decision to the commit it was made on: once the branch moves past it, the decision no longer covers the new commits and the branch is stranded again. `npm run check:stranded-work-ledger` validates every entry. None of the recovery task's outcomes is a default: check for a recorded decision on the branch's commits and files first, because some branches are left or held on purpose.
